items.text: All of the email campaigns are in your dashboard, so you can see them any time. We'll also send you an email and text as the holiday comes up, so you can see it before it goes out.

items.text: Use WeFood to send text message blasts to your customers. Many of your customers opt-in to receive text messages from you to receive order updates, so it’s a great way to stay top of mind.

items.text: Texts are the perfect way to create a surge in sales, with data showing that they have a 95% open rate. Use them to send customers your latest updates, specials, and exclusive discounts.

items.title: Spy on competitors for free
items.text: With WeFood's website grader, uncover competitors’ strategies without signing up or paying. Enter your restaurant’s name, and our tool scans Google search rankings, reviews, and directories. Get tailored insights to help you outperform local competition.

items.title: Fix costly errors in your online presence
items.text: Beyond competitors, the grader identifies errors in your online profiles—missing keywords, incomplete details, or unoptimized content—so you can fix them and recover lost sales opportunities.

items.title: Maximize promotions with AI-powered testing
items.text: Our Smart Coupons system uses AI to test and optimize promotions. It finds the perfect discount level to boost sales while minimizing costs, saving you from unnecessary giveaways.

items.title: Reduce waste and protect profits
items.text: By running promotions smarter, you avoid overspending on discounts, keeping your net profits high even with rising food costs and inflation.

items.title: Boost sales with a faster checkout experience
items.text: Our lightning checkout system increases checkout speeds by over 25%. Guests love the convenience, leading to higher conversion rates and more repeat orders.

items.title: Encourage direct orders with accelerated checkout
items.text: With Apple Pay and Google Pay now at the top of checkout, your website becomes as fast and easy as WeFood or UberEats—bringing more orders directly to you.

items.title: Create your own mobile app for your restaurant
items.text: Creating a mobile app for your customers can help increase reorders by 85%+. Make the online ordering experience seamless with saved favorites and recorded payment information.

items.title: Offer a loyalty program just like national chains
items.text: Run a loyalty program your regulars will love. Offer them a no-brainer sign-up offer, keep them engaged with valuable loyalty points and grow your profits by generating consistent orders.

items.title: Customize all your email marketing campaigns
items.text: You’ll still have access to our suite of proven email marketing templates, but now you can supercharge them with full creative control of your email marketing campaigns (changing the copy, images, sequence, and more).

items.question: What happens to my current website?
items.answer_html:
When you sign up with WeFood, you'll get a new restaurant website optimized for traffic and sales. It will replace your current website.

Your domain and website URL will stay the same.

We won't delete your current website. If you ever decide to cancel your subscription with us, we will restore your website to how it was before you signed up.

items.question: How much can I customize my design?
items.answer_html:
We believe sales is the most important thing. So we give you a proven design that you can personalize with your branding.

It's why restaurant websites with WeFood look a certain way. We've studied the best online brands. We've driven over $100 million in sales for restaurants. We've helped thousands of restaurant WeFood grow their customer base with our websites.

If you're looking for a lot of design freedom, WeFood is not the right fit for your business.

items.question: How long will this take?
items.answer_html:
If you have everything ready to go, a few days.

Most customers get their new online presence set up within about a week.

We'll need some information about your business when you sign up.

This includes your website domain information, along with Google Business and Yelp details. The more of those you have on hand, the faster we can launch.

Yes, it’s another way we help you drive sales.

Here’s the data from the thousands of restaurants we work with: 80% of your regulars want apps from their favorite restaurants. Roughly 1 in 2 of your regulars will download your app. People who install restaurant apps order 85% more frequently.

items.question: Do you build me a custom app from scratch?

Your app, like your online ordering, is based on proven systems that drive sales.

You'll be able to personalize your app with your brand and customize your rewards program.

If you were to build an app from scratch, it would cost you at least 5 figures and take months. Using a tried-and-tested mobile app design is how we can launch you in weeks.

items.question: How are delivery fees calculated?

We offer transparent, predictable pricing with no commissions on your direct orders.

Fees depend on distance, time, and driver availability. You can set delivery zones and minimums to protect your margins.

items.question: Can I use my own drivers?

Yes. Use your own drivers, our network, or a mix of both. We support flexible dispatch so you always have coverage.

Your drivers get optimized routes and optional live tracking for customers.

items.question: What are some examples of your proven campaigns?
items.answer_html:
We automate campaigns that we know drive sales. For example, 'abandoned cart' emails. When a customer adds food to their cart but doesn't complete their order, we'll send them an email or text to come back.

This is a best practice in eCommerce, and it works great for online ordering too.

Another example is holiday email campaigns. For example, we'll send a Mother's Day email with a limited-time coupon code.

Since these types of emails work across all restaurants, we've automated them for you. You'll grow sales without having to write dozens of email or text blast campaigns.

items.question: Can I run my own marketing campaigns?
items.answer_html: Absolutely. You can use our pre-built marketing campaigns, or you can build your own. It’s easy to send your own emails, and we make it easier with our AI writing assistant.

items.question: Should I stop using third party apps?
items.answer_html:
Many of our customers stay on the apps, as they can be a good way to get new customers.

We'll help you to convert those customers to order directly from you, using your new online ordering system.

items.question: How can I get my customers to order directly?
items.answer_html:
Always remind customers to order from your website or app.

We'll help by giving you flyers that have a QR code. You can put these in takeout bags, or hand them to customers in-store.

We'll also pay for promotions to help you get customers on your email list.

Once you get more customers ordering through your website, we'll keep them coming back. When they visit your website on their phone, we'll promote your mobile app. These drive 85% more repeat orders for you.

items.question: What POS systems do you integrate with?
items.answer_html:
We have native integrations with Square and Clover. We also connect to many POS systems through Otter.

We can also send you a tablet or printer (at no extra fee) if that's what you'd prefer.

items.question: I already use another OLO, why should I switch to WeFood?
items.answer_html:
Many restaurants switch to WeFood because they know they can get more online sales. Their current OLO either doesn't drive enough orders, or their customers don't like using it.

Everything we do is based on growing your online orders.

Our online ordering system drives orders at 2-4X more than the average restaurant website. That's because we've based our OLO on the best restaurant and food apps.

With WeFood, your OLO also comes with a mobile app. Your app is modeled after the best apps in the industry. It's how we've helped our customers get thousands of 5-star reviews on app stores.

retreats.desc: We love building real friendships with everyone that we work with, so we do several retreats per year in fun destinations – to deepen our friendships, celebrate our wins, and plan our future.

obsess.title: Obsess over customers
obsess.desc: We embrace the truth that customer success is our success, and prioritize that above all else. It’s the first thing we think about in all that we do. We treat customer relationships like we expect them to last decades, always optimizing for the long term. We align our incentives with our customers. We are generous with our time to go above and beyond for our customers, and aim to deliver the best experiences they’ve ever had with any company.

energy.title: Bring good energy
energy.desc: We’re optimistic about the future and grateful about where we are, and our high-energy culture spills into the world around us. We celebrate our wins and the wins of our customers. The good vibes brighten every interaction we have with our teammates, customers and partners. We recognize that startups are too hard to dwell on the negatives, and that part of the challenge is to keep a positive view of the future even while solving the most trying problems.

speed.title: Move fast
speed.desc: We live or die by how fast we get things done. Speed is the most important advantage that startups have. We set aggressive timelines that the world tells us are impossible. We don’t depend on external folks for our core timelines — whether they are vendors, restaurant partners, or even other teams. We cannot and will not move at someone else’s pace. We set our own timelines and find a way to make them happen. When setting timelines, we default to thinking in hours and days — not weeks and months.

owner.title: Build as an Owner
owner.desc: Every person on our team is an WeFood in our business. Our goal is to inspire our teams rather than to manage them. We trust people on our team to do what they think is best for WeFood, giving them freedom and information in support of their decisions. When we see problems, small or large, we never think 'that’s not my job'. Instead, we have a sense of responsibility and ownership that pushes us to always go above and beyond to make our business better. It’s not enough just to execute tasks in the same way every day. Everyone on the team is responsible for consistently improving systems and improving the company by 1% every day.

scale.title: Scale yourself
scale.desc: The first thing that we look for in new teammates is a high rate of learning, because startups change so quickly that learning quickly is necessary for thriving in them. We believe that reading is a superpower because it allows us to learn from experts. We can compress experts’ years of learning into hours by studying books, courses, and interviews. We constantly seek out insights from people who are better than we are. Our company is scaling fast, and we must scale our knowledge with it to keep pace.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer_html:
We set up most restaurants within a week. You’ll have an onboarding specialist to guide you through the process. They will need information about your business to get you up and running.

You’ll need to share access to your key accounts (your domain, Google and Yelp profiles). We’ll ask about basics like your EIN and your POS. We use Stripe to help you accept payments online, so you’ll set up an account with them if you don’t already have one.

From there, we’ll update your new website with your branding. We’ll also use your menu to set up your online ordering.

If you have everything in order, like knowing the login and password to all of your accounts, this can be done very quickly. If that’s the case, you can be up and running in a few days.

“As long as you're ready, they get right into work. It only took us about two days.”

Sandy Sei, WeFood of Cyclo Noodles

items.question: Do you take over my POS?
items.answer_html:
No, but we can automatically inject orders into many of the major POS systems. If it’s Clover or Square, we integrate directly so all the orders online go straight to your POS. We can also send you a tablet or printer (at no extra fee) if that's what you'd prefer.

“Now that we’ve used WeFood for 1 year, I can say confidently that it is the best technology in our restaurant.”

Phillip Hang, WeFood of Sushi Me Roll'n

items.question: How do you get customers to switch from delivery apps?
items.answer_html:
First, we help you educate your customers. We do things like sending you flyers (at no additional cost) to put in your outgoing delivery orders, letting customers know that they'll save money ordering directly from you next time. We’ll also make sure the link in your Google Business Profile points to your own website instead of third-party apps.

Second, your online ordering experience with WeFood.com is as good as the delivery apps, so guests enjoy coming back to your website and app.

Third, we'll set up your reward program, so customers earn points when they order direct, and claim points for free food in future orders.

“For my customers to order through me directly, my online ordering system has to be better than Uber and WeFood. Our solution was WeFood.com.”

Mo Farraj, WeFood of Talkin Tacos
